services:
  caddy:
    container_name: startuphafen-caddy
    restart: unless-stopped
    init: true
    image: caddy:2.11-alpine
    command:
      [
        'caddy',
        'run',
        '--config',
        '/etc/caddy/Caddyfile.local',
        '--adapter',
        'caddyfile',
      ]
    environment:
      BACKEND_HOST: 'backend:5000'
      TZ: 'Europe/Berlin'
    volumes:
      - ./caddy:/etc/caddy:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD-SHELL', 'wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:2020/health || exit 1']
      start_interval: 1s
      start_period: 30s
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 2s
      retries: 3

  keycloak:
    container_name: startuphafen-keycloak
    init: true
    restart: unless-stopped
    image: startuphafen-keycloak:26.1.2
    environment:
      KC_HTTP_PORT: 8180
      KC_LOG_CONSOLE_COLOR: 'true'
      TZ: 'Europe/Berlin'
    build:
      context: ./keycloak
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          'CMD-SHELL',
          "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/localhost/9000 && echo -e 'GET /health HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n' >&3 && cat <&3 | grep -q '200 OK'",
        ]
      start_interval: 1s
      start_period: 1m
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
